title: About
summary: About Allen Technical Solutions: our experience, approach and values.
keywords: about company team founder story mission values approach
text: Who we are Built by an engineer, for people who build Allen Technical Solutions is an engineer-led firm with more than 26 years of experience in controls, automation, test and validation across the automotive, industrial and transportation industries. Our background is in leading engineering teams, running complex technical programs, and building real-time control systems, calibration strategies and automated test environments. We focus on reducing technical risk, improving product quality and turning customer requirements into solutions that scale. Electrical and communication engineering foundation Six Sigma-style process improvement Functional safety and cybersecurity for software releases Customer support across North America and Europe We pair that foundation with modern AI-assisted tools, so a small, engineer-led team can take on software, apps and web projects alongside traditional engineering, with every deliverable reviewed by an engineer. Based in Indianapolis, Indiana, working with clients anywhere. Experience Where our experience comes from Controls & Automation Real-time and embedded control systems, Linux-based platforms, industrial communications, custom I/O and machine safety. Test & Validation Automated test environments, hardware-in-the-loop simulation, data acquisition, test instrumentation, calibration and product validation. Engineering Leadership Leading engineering teams and technical programs, OEM and customer engineering, standards compliance and release management. Our approach How every project runs Listen Understand the real problem, not just the requested feature. Specify Write down requirements and acceptance criteria together. Build with AI Use AI-assisted tools to design, code and test quickly, in visible increments. Verify & support Engineer review against acceptance criteria, documentation and ongoing support. Values What we hold ourselves to Integrity Honest estimates, and we tell you when something isn't worth building. Precision Measured results and work that is checked before it ships. Clarity Plain-language updates and documentation you can use. Craft Pride in clean designs, clean code and lasting solutions.
